Messages.Author: Sorrow
Messages.Body:
Card Title: Bindusara, Historian of the Kindred
Capacity: 9
Disciplines: DOM FOR PRE AUS tha
Clan: Ventrue
Text: Bindusara can take an action to allow you to search
your library for an Elder Library, Arcane Library, or
Fragment of the Book of Nod; put that card in play.
(Pay cost as normal.) Shuffle your library afterwards.
+1 bleed

Ok, so I want to pull out an Arcane Library and put it into
play. However, I don't control any Tremere. Yes, the
rules state that you much control the clan that any card
requires to be put into play. Yet, Bindusara's special says
to put it into play irregardless of whether or not you control
a Tremere. I know that in almost all situations that the card
text overrides the rules. Is this one of those cases?

Sorrow
